event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Tech wreck, broad tape held, oil collapsed.
Oct ISM Manufacturing printed 55.5 vs 54.6 fc (S&P Global final 54.9 vs 56 fc) — the cyclical/reopening read, not the chip tape, set the day: XLY, XLF and XLB led while SOXX fell 3.79% and XLE -3.96% on a -7.08% WTI collapse. Real rotation out of AI hardware into consumer/industrial/credit-sensitive value, with small > large by 1.33pp confirming it.

INDICES — VIX 21.1, above its 17.3 20-day MA.
Ranked: SLV +2.17%, GLD +1.65%, IJR +0.85%, IJH +0.80%, RSP +0.76%, DIA +0.43%, IWM -0.07%, SPY -0.48%, QQQ -1.36%, SOXX -3.79%. Small beat large by 1.33pp. Most notable cross-asset move: USO -7.08%. QQQ is 9.93% below its 20-day trend and SOXX 23.05% — momentum break territory; verify 200-DMA before sizing CTAs.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.0x (ignored), QQQ 1.4x (active). SPY's light volume on -0.48% is benign drift, not distribution; QQQ 1.4x down is real distribution in megacap tech. XLK 1.6x gaining volume with XLK -2.95% is textbook distribution despite the "gaining" label — treat it as selling. Breadth confirms: 68% advancers, 342/160 A/D, 66% above 50DMA, 90 new highs vs 38 lows, narrow rally False.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLY Discretionary +2.41%, XLF Financials +1.86%, XLB Materials +1.76%, XLP Staples +1.58%, XLI Industrials +1.38%, XLRE Real Estate +1.09%, XLU Utilities +0.55%, XLC Comms +0.36%, XLV Healthcare -0.15%, XLK Technology -2.95%, XLE Energy -3.96%.
Top industries MSOS +6.60% and TAN +4.65%; bottom FCG -5.45% and OIH -5.48%. Flows confirm price: XLF +$781mm (86p) and XLI +$529mm (85p) inflows vs XLE -$82mm (35p) — money is chasing the leaders, not short-covering. Money in: consumer discretionary, financials. Money out: energy, semis. Rotation state: broad risk-on, excluding AI hardware.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.28 and QQQ 1.08 = protection demand, not complacency; skews +12.8%/+9.5% keep puts bid. QQQ IV 39.3% vs SPY 22.5% shows the stress is concentrated in tech. VIXEQ 44.7 vs VIX 21.1 — a 23.6-point gap = high single-stock dispersion, low implied correlation; a stock-picker's tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -7.08% into airlines +4.16% (JETS) and consumer discretionary +2.41% is a direct margin-relief chain; gold +1.65% and silver +2.17% rallying despite a flat dollar (-0.14%) reads as hedges against the QQQ vol, not risk-off. Next FOMC Dec 9: Polymarket pricing 72% for a 25bp hike (-6pp in 5d) vs 26% hold, while CME FedWatch shows hike 100% — the rate path is the tail risk for this rotation.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 50.9, neutral. Movers: MRVL -12.72% (2.7x volume), INTC -8.80%, ORCL -8.76%. Best 20d sector XLP +12.08%, worst XLK -13.29%. Watch: SOXX -3.79% into Dec 9 hike odds, TAN +4.65% on 2.7x (accumulation), and XLE at 5d -3.43% with inflows gone — a momentum break below the 20d +5.99%.
